subject: general
question: Which of the following countries was the runner-up in the ICC U-19 Cricket World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**__**ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup **2022:__

__
 
• It is an** international limited-overs cricket** tournament, held in January-February 2022 in West Indies. 
 
• **16 teams** took part in the game. It was the **fourteenth edition **of the Under-19 Cricket World Cup.
 
• **Bangladesh were the defending champions. **
 
• The final match was played at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium in Antigua between India and England. 
 
• India cruised to a four-wicket victory against England. Thus **England were the runner-up in this tournament.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup is an international cricket tournament organised by the International Cricket Council (ICC) contested by** national under-19 teams.**
 
• It was first contested in **1988, as the Youth World Cup.**
 
• **India, the most successful team** at U19 World Cups, has won **titles in 2000, 2008, 2012 and 2018 previously.**
 
• New Zealand withdrew from the tournament because of extensive mandatory quarantine restrictions for minors on their return home.
 
• Scotland was named as their replacement.
